caption: The drawing depicts a green, long-sleeved coat with a high collar and wide cuffs, featuring gold buttons on the cuffs and pockets. The coat, which extends to below the knees, has slits in the front and shows a beige or cream-colored lining. Attached to the collar is a loose, beige cravat with a lacy edge that hangs down the front. At the bottom corners of the coat, there are black buckled straps. The background is plain and off-white, with a small outlined technical sketch of the coat’s back view in the upper right corner. The object's composition is centralized on the page, and the signature at the bottom right credits Mary E. Humes and references the Federal Art Project, W.P.A. of VA.
title: Man's Suit
